Goal: Build and Maintain a Secure Network and Systems
Title: NSC processes defined
Description: Processes and mechanisms for installing and maintaining network security controls are defined and understood.

Goal: Build and Maintain a Secure Network and Systems
Title: NSCs configured and maintained
Description: Network security controls (NSCs) are configured and maintained.

Goal: Build and Maintain a Secure Network and Systems
Title: CDE network access restricted
Description: Network access to and from the cardholder data environment (CDE) is restricted.

Goal: Build and Maintain a Secure Network and Systems
Title: Trusted/untrusted network connections controlled
Description: Network connections between trusted and untrusted networks are controlled.

Goal: Build and Maintain a Secure Network and Systems
Title: Dual-connected device risk mitigated
Description: Risks to the CDE from computing devices able to connect to both untrusted networks and the CDE are mitigated.

Goal: Build and Maintain a Secure Network and Systems
Title: Secure configuration processes defined
Description: Processes and mechanisms for applying secure configurations to all system components are defined and understood.

Goal: Build and Maintain a Secure Network and Systems
Title: System components securely configured
Description: System components are configured and managed securely.

Goal: Build and Maintain a Secure Network and Systems
Title: Wireless environments secured
Description: Wireless environments are configured and managed securely.

Title: Stored data protection processes defined
Description: Processes and mechanisms for protecting stored account data are defined and understood.

Title: Storage minimized
Description: Storage of account data is kept to a minimum.

Title: SAD not stored after authorization
Description: Sensitive authentication data (SAD) is not stored after authorization.

Title: PAN display/copy restricted
Description: Access to displays of full PAN and ability to copy PAN is restricted.

Title: PAN secured wherever stored
Description: Primary account number (PAN) is secured wherever it is stored.

Title: Cryptographic keys secured
Description: Cryptographic keys used to protect stored account data are secured.

Title: Key management processes defined
Description: Where cryptography is used to protect stored account data, key management processes are defined and implemented.

Title: Transmission protection processes defined
Description: Processes and mechanisms for protecting cardholder data with strong cryptography during transmission are defined and understood.

Title: PAN protected during transmission
Description: PAN is protected with strong cryptography during transmission over open public networks.

Title: Anti-malware processes defined
Description: Processes and mechanisms for protecting systems and networks from malicious software are defined and understood.

Title: Malware prevented/detected
Description: Malicious software (malware) is prevented, or detected and addressed.

Title: Anti-malware mechanisms maintained
Description: Anti-malware mechanisms and processes are active, maintained, and monitored.

Title: Anti-phishing mechanisms
Description: Anti-phishing mechanisms protect users against phishing attacks.

Title: Secure development processes defined
Description: Processes and mechanisms for developing and maintaining secure systems and software are defined and understood.

Title: Bespoke/custom software developed securely
Description: Bespoke and custom software are developed securely.

Title: Vulnerabilities identified and addressed
Description: Security vulnerabilities are identified and addressed.

Title: Public-facing web apps protected
Description: Public-facing web applications are protected against attacks.

Title: Changes managed securely
Description: Changes to all system components are managed securely.

Title: Need-to-know access processes defined
Description: Processes and mechanisms for restricting access to system components and cardholder data by business need to know are defined and understood.

Title: Access appropriately defined/assigned
Description: Access to system components and data is appropriately defined and assigned.

Title: Access control system(s) used
Description: Access to system components and data is managed via an access control system(s).

Title: Identification/authentication processes defined
Description: Processes and mechanisms for identifying users and authenticating access to system components are defined and understood.

Title: User IDs/accounts strictly managed
Description: User identification and related accounts for users and administrators are strictly managed.

Title: Strong authentication established
Description: Strong authentication for users and administrators is established and managed.

Title: MFA implemented for CDE access
Description: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is implemented to secure access into the CDE.

Title: MFA configured to prevent misuse
Description: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) systems are configured to prevent misuse.

Title: System/application accounts managed
Description: Use of application and system accounts and associated authentication factors is strictly managed.

Title: Physical access processes defined
Description: Processes and mechanisms for restricting physical access to cardholder data are defined and understood.

Title: Physical access controls manage entry
Description: Physical access controls manage entry into facilities and systems containing cardholder data.

Title: Personnel/visitor physical access managed
Description: Physical access for personnel and visitors is authorized and managed.

Title: Media securely handled
Description: Media with cardholder data is securely stored accessed distributed and destroyed.

Title: POI devices protected
Description: Point of interaction (POI) devices are protected from tampering and unauthorized substitution.

Title: Logging processes defined
Description: Processes and mechanisms for logging and monitoring all access to system components are defined and understood.

Title: Audit logs implemented
Description: Audit logs are implemented to support the detection of anomalies and suspicious activity.

Title: Audit logs protected
Description: Audit logs are protected from destruction and unauthorized modification.

Title: Audit logs reviewed
Description: Audit logs are reviewed to identify anomalies or suspicious activity.

Title: Audit log history retained
Description: Audit log history is retained and available for analysis.

Title: Time synchronization
Description: Time-synchronization mechanisms support consistent time settings across all systems.

Title: Critical security control failures detected
Description: Failures of critical security control systems are detected reported and responded to.

Title: Security testing processes defined
Description: Processes and mechanisms for testing security of systems and networks regularly are defined and understood.

Title: Wireless access points monitored
Description: Wireless access points are identified and monitored and unauthorized ones are addressed.

Title: Vulnerabilities identified/addressed
Description: External and internal vulnerabilities are regularly identified prioritized and addressed.

Title: Penetration testing performed
Description: External and internal penetration testing is regularly performed.

Title: Intrusions/file changes detected
Description: Network intrusions and unexpected file changes are detected and responded to.

Title: Payment page changes detected
Description: Unauthorized changes on payment pages are detected and responded to.

Title: Information security policy current
Description: A comprehensive information security policy that governs and provides direction for protection of the entity's information assets is known and current.

Title: Acceptable use policies defined
Description: Acceptable use policies for end-user technologies are defined and implemented.

Title: CDE risks formally managed
Description: Risks to the cardholder data environment are formally identified evaluated and managed.

Title: PCI DSS compliance managed
Description: PCI DSS compliance is managed.

Title: PCI DSS scope documented/validated
Description: PCI DSS scope is documented and validated.

Title: Security awareness ongoing
Description: Security awareness education is an ongoing activity.

Title: Personnel screened
Description: Personnel are screened to reduce risks from insider threats.

Title: TPSP risk managed
Description: Risk to information assets associated with third-party service provider (TPSP) relationships is managed.

Title: TPSPs support customer compliance
Description: Third-party service providers (TPSPs) support their customers' PCI DSS compliance.

Title: Incidents responded to immediately
Description: Suspected and confirmed security incidents that could impact the CDE are responded to immediately.
